en.formulaTitle: In-Memory Relational Engine & ANSI SQL Query Execution Architecture
en.formulaDescription: The SQL editor provides an in-browser relational database query runner. It parses and executes standard ANSI SQL statements (CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO, SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY) against an isolated in-memory relational schema, rendering results as interactive data tables with zero server communication.

stepByStep.title: Choose or Write SQL Schema
stepByStep.instruction: Load a sample schema (Employees, Orders, Products) or write your own CREATE TABLE and INSERT statements.

stepByStep.title: Compose SQL Queries
stepByStep.instruction: Write SELECT queries with WHERE filters, JOIN clauses, aggregation functions, and ORDER BY.

stepByStep.title: Execute Query
stepByStep.instruction: Click Run Query or press Ctrl+Enter to execute statements in the in-memory engine.

stepByStep.title: Inspect Results & Export
stepByStep.instruction: Review rows and columns in the interactive table grid and click Download to save queries as script.sql.

workedExample.title: Department Salary Aggregation with SQL JOIN
workedExample.scenario: Joining employees and departments tables to compute average salary per department.
workedExample.calculation: SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS count, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_sal FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_sal DESC;
workedExample.result: Results Grid: Rendered 3 rows (Engineering, Marketing, Sales) with formatted currency columns in 2ms.

faqs.question: Which database engine powers this online SQL editor?
faqs.answer: This SQL editor is powered by an in-browser SQLite WebAssembly engine. Queries run 100% locally on your computer with instantaneous performance.

faqs.question: Are sample tables and data preloaded?
faqs.answer: Yes, sample relational tables (employees, departments, orders, products) are preloaded so you can practice SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and JOIN queries immediately.

faqs.question: Can I create my own custom tables?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can run CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE queries to build and alter your own custom schemas.

faqs.question: Can I export SQL query results?
faqs.answer: Yes, query results can be viewed in responsive HTML tables and exported as CSV or JSON format with a single click.

faqs.question: Is this connected to a live production database server?
faqs.answer: No. The SQL editor operates an isolated in-memory relational schema inside your browser. Your queries and records never touch external database servers.

faqs.question: Do database tables persist when the browser page is refreshed?
faqs.answer: No. Because tables reside in temporary browser memory, reloading the page resets the schema to initial sample data.

faqs.question: Which SQL dialects and clauses are supported?
faqs.answer: Standard ANSI SQL syntax is supported, including SELECT, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE TABLE, WHERE, JOIN (INNER, LEFT), GROUP BY, HAVING, and ORDER BY.

faqs.question: Can I export the query results or SQL script?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can copy table rows to your clipboard or download your written queries as a standalone .sql script file.

pt.formulaTitle: Motor Relacional em Memória e Arquitetura de Consultas ANSI SQL
pt.formulaDescription: O editor SQL fornece um executor de consultas relacionais em memória no próprio navegador. Executa instruções ANSI SQL padrão (CREATE, INSERT, SELECT, JOIN) gerando tabelas interativas sem contato com servidores externos.

stepByStep.title: Escolher ou criar esquema
stepByStep.instruction: Carregue uma tabela de exemplo ou escreva comandos CREATE TABLE e INSERT.

stepByStep.title: Elaborar consultas SQL
stepByStep.instruction: Crie consultas SELECT com filtros WHERE, junções JOIN e ordenação.

stepByStep.title: Executar consulta
stepByStep.instruction: Clique em Run Query ou use Ctrl+Enter para rodar no motor em memória.

stepByStep.title: Ver tabela e baixar
stepByStep.instruction: Examine as linhas resultantes na grade e salve o arquivo como script.sql.

workedExample.title: Exemplo de Consulta SQL com JOIN e GROUP BY
workedExample.scenario: Junção de tabelas de funcionários e departamentos para calcular média salarial.
workedExample.calculation: SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_sal FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name;
workedExample.result: Grade de dados: 3 linhas geradas com métricas completas em 2 ms.

faqs.question: Which database engine powers this online SQL editor?
faqs.answer: This SQL editor is powered by an in-browser SQLite WebAssembly engine. Queries run 100% locally on your computer with instantaneous performance.

faqs.question: Are sample tables and data preloaded?
faqs.answer: Yes, sample relational tables (employees, departments, orders, products) are preloaded so you can practice SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and JOIN queries immediately.

faqs.question: Can I create my own custom tables?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can run CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO, UPDATE, and DELETE queries to build and alter your own custom schemas.

faqs.question: Can I export SQL query results?
faqs.answer: Yes, query results can be viewed in responsive HTML tables and exported as CSV or JSON format with a single click.

faqs.question: Existe conexão com bancos de dados em produção?
faqs.answer: Não. O editor roda em uma estrutura em memória no navegador com segurança e total privacidade.

faqs.question: Os dados permanecem se eu atualizar a página?
faqs.answer: Não. Por estarem na memória volátil da aba, ao recarregar a página as tabelas voltam ao modelo inicial.

faqs.question: Quais comandos SQL são suportados?
faqs.answer: Suporta a sintaxe ANSI SQL: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE TABLE, JOINs, GROUP BY e ORDER BY.

faqs.question: É possível baixar as consultas digitadas?
faqs.answer: Sim. Você pode exportar seu script completo em formato de arquivo .sql.

ko.formulaTitle: 인메모리 관계형 엔진 및 ANSI SQL 쿼리 실행 구조
ko.formulaDescription: 본 SQL 에디터는 브라우저 내부에서 동작하는 인메모리 관계형 데이터베이스 쿼리 실행기입니다. CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO, SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY 등의 표준 ANSI SQL 문을 즉각 실행하여 표 형태의 결과를 실시간 렌더링합니다.

stepByStep.title: 스키마 선택 또는 정의
stepByStep.instruction: 샘플 테이블(직원, 주문 등)을 불러오거나 직접 CREATE TABLE 및 INSERT 문을 작성합니다.

stepByStep.title: SQL 쿼리문 작성
stepByStep.instruction: WHERE 조건, JOIN 결합, GROUP BY 집계, ORDER BY 정렬이 포함된 SELECT 문을 작성합니다.

stepByStep.title: 쿼리 실행
stepByStep.instruction: Run Query 버튼 또는 Ctrl+Enter를 눌러 인메모리 엔진에서 즉시 쿼리를 수행합니다.

stepByStep.title: 결과 테이블 확인 및 저장
stepByStep.instruction: 그리드 표로 출력된 데이터 레코드를 점검하고 script.sql 파일로 다운로드합니다.

workedExample.title: SQL JOIN 결합 및 부서별 평균 급여 집계 실전 예시
workedExample.scenario: 직원(employees) 테이블과 부서(departments) 테이블을 JOIN하여 부서별 인원수 및 평균 급여 산출.
workedExample.calculation: SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS count, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_sal FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name;
workedExample.result: 결과 그리드: 3개 부서별 집계 데이터가 2ms 만에 인터랙티브 표 형태로 즉각 표시.
